model_annotation: This bar chart displays the percentage share of three metals—Aluminium, Kupfer (Copper), and Nickel—for two regions, Deutschland (Germany) and the EU, across the years 2021, 2022, and 2023. The horizontal axis lists the three metal categories in order from left to right, while the vertical axis represents the percentage (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. For each metal, three adjacent bars represent the respective years: blue for 2021, purple for 2022, and gray for 2023, with exact percentage values labeled atop each bar. In Deutschland, Aluminium shows values of 3.6% (2021), 2.7% (2022), and 1.0% (2023); Kupfer shows 8.3% (2021), 11.3% (2022), and 2.2% (2023); and Nickel shows 25.1% (2021), 24.7% (2022), and 11.4% (2023). In the EU, Aluminium shows 3.2% (2021), 2.8% (2022), and 1.7% (2023); Kupfer shows 4.4% (2021), 5.1% (2022), and 1.3% (2023); and Nickel shows 24.3% (2021), 23.3% (2022), and 14.6% (2023). The bars are not sorted by value but presented in the same order for both regions, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coding and labeling.
